verdict.language_detail: MATLAB (polynomial zonotope arithmetic for reachability, ARMOUR/ARMTD robotics)
verdict.provenance_detail: Hand-written research code for ARMOUR/ARMTD robot arm motion planning, computing joint reachable sets (JRS) online using polynomial zonotope arithmetic
verdict.purpose: Computes joint reachable sets (JRS) online for a robot arm using polynomial zonotope arithmetic, supporting both original ARMTD and Bernstein trajectory parameterizations, with tracking error bounds and rotation matrix computation.
